members.name: fable-council (claude-fable-5, high)
members.verdict: Three painter constants (track 0.28-0.30, fractional geometry, no minimum fill) plus the wrong default mark; cut Letters and Column; default TextBar+Digits+Used

members.name: codex-council (gpt-5.6-sol, xhigh)
members.verdict: Endpoint geometry is the defect, not size; framed 4px gauge + endpoint protection; theme-dependent tracks 0.40/0.50; default Linear+Initials+Remaining; merge Number/Letters/Bar/Column into Linear; cap Rundown at 5

members.name: grok-council (grok-4.6, high)
members.verdict: Sub-pixel fill + 0.30 tracks + unframed default bar; tracks 0.50, 2px/24deg fill floor, framed TextBar 4px, ring end-cap ticks, Rundown cap 4; keep Used, remove Letters, keep Column

synthesis.subject: Headroom tray-icon readability at 16 px (near-zero usage)
synthesis.absent_seats: kimi-k3 (council_glm52 null on this machine); Google not servable by design
consensus: root cause is painter constants not the slot: track alpha below visibility, no fill floor, fractional geometry
frames at alpha 1.0, integer-snapped at <24 px; tracks ~0.42 dark / 0.52 light (light taskbar contrast is lower)
4 px framed gauge under the text; endpoint protection: any non-zero fill >=1 px, any non-full leaves >=1 px
ring 2.5 px stroke below 20 px with solid end caps; narrow '1' glyph so 100 fits
rundown: 2 px bars, cap 5, solid dash for no data
remove Letters (fold into TextBar+Initials); identity = initials + opt-in colour, never shape families

dissent.default_measure: codex: Remaining; fable+grok: Used (relocates the empty state to the critical moment). RULING: Used stays default; Remaining per icon
dissent.default_mark: fable+grok: Digits; codex: Initials. RULING: digits on the first icon, initials on additional icons
dissent.column: fable+codex remove; grok keep. RULING: remove, migrate to Bar

synthesis.decision: implement the consensus change list now; validator != implementer on the build
